facts.text: I am trying to research the history of my great-grandfather's navigation tool from the early 20th century.
I found an antique silver locket that has been passed down through generations.
The antique silver locket has been around for over 100 years.
I think the navigation tool is a sextant.
The sextant has engravings on it.
The sextant has no markings or labels that I can find.
I will take pictures of the sextant and send them.
The antique silver locket has a small diamond in the center.
The antique silver locket has intricate engravings around the diamond.
I am thinking of getting my rare 1980s vinyl record appraised to determine its value.
I am thinking of getting my vintage Omega Seamaster watch serviced and refurbished to maintain its value.
I am planning to get my rare 1913 Liberty Head nickel graded and certified by a reputable coin grading service.
I think I got carried away with the coin grading services and want a more concise response.
